These sector positions operationalize the NZBA targets: the thermal coal zero-lending policy by 2025 complements the 100% NZBA reduction target by 2030 (23% progress in FY22); the oil and gas project finance restrictions complement the 23% NZBA reduction target (18% progress in FY22). Sector positions provide explicit financing restrictions, while NZBA targets measure portfolio-level emission reduction trajectories.

Oil & gas: no project finance/bond for new/expansion greenfield fields. Thermal coal: zero lending to >=15% coal customers by Sep 2025. These complement NZBA: coal zero-lending aligns with 100% reduction target; oil/gas restrictions support 23% reduction target.
